title: Publish deployment.migrate_down in the shared runtime contract and regenerate the client
description:
SPIDR child of task-537320eed95348dc9bc3afc879dc0563 (architect-fa3a3e17, 2026-09-05). Independent - no dependsOn.

WHY THIS ROW EXISTS: I filed the parent as one row and then measured it against my own numbers - the shared-contract half is 6 files and the daemon half is 8 plus the revert proof, which is 15 together against a 10-file cap. This is the contract half. The parent keeps the daemon wiring, the human-only fence, the bidirectional roster test and the revert proof.

THE SPLIT IS SAFE AND PRECEDENTED: apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-create-with-source.ts:35 documents that `goal.create_with_source` IS in RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS and NOT in the daemon table. The shared contract and the daemon roster are deliberately NOT set-equal, so the HEAD this row leaves - the kind advertised, not yet served - is a landed, documented state rather than a hole. Cite that file if anyone files the gap as a defect.

MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-fa3a3e17, 2026-09-05:
- `RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS` is a flat FROZEN, SORTED tuple of kind strings at packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:85. Insert at the sorted position; runtime-contract.test.ts:117-125 asserts the tuple equals its own sort AGAINST THE PRODUCTION TUPLE, and its comment records why: `product_contract.approve_gate_1` once landed at the wrong position, was copied into the hand transcription at that same wrong position, and BOTH stayed green.
- runtime-contract.test.ts:29-34 explains the transcription is deliberate: "an expectation computed from the tuple under test can never fail, which is what the previous `commands.size === RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS.length` arm did." So EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS at :35 is hand-copied and `expect(commands.size).toBe(N)` at :105 is a hand-written literal. Note :104's comment reads "Literal 102" above an assertion of 104 and is ALREADY STALE - fix it to match while you are in the line.
- THERE IS NO PER-KIND PAYLOAD SCHEMA, deliberately. packages/control-room-client/generator/generate.ts:37-39: "Payloads stay JsonObject. No per-kind payload schema exists in the contract, and generating per-kind payload types would invent a contract that does not exist." Payload KEYS belong to the parent's daemon-side PAYLOAD_KEYS edit. Adding a payload type here is a rejection, not compliance.
- THE GENERATOR is `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate` (package.json:18 = `node --experimental-strip-types generator/generate.ts`); it emits the command section from a sorted copy of RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS (:289) and writes the digest literal at :264, hashing `canonicalContractSurface()` (contract-digest.ts:30, :55).

CENSUS THE DIGEST BY ITS HEX, NEVER BY ITS SYMBOL. A `git grep GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST` finds ONE literal and wrongly suggests regeneration cascades everywhere; THREE OF THE FOUR MIRRORS never mention the symbol and hard-code the hex, and one is a `.tsx` a `*.ts`-only grep cannot see.
